rationale: The agent processed returns but did not honor the user’s explicit condition to refund each order to the opposite payment method. The tool calls show refunds were sent to the same/original payment methods, not the requested opposites. Moreover, there is no clear confirmation step before performing the order-changing writes, which the policy requires. Only after executing the returns did the agent hand off to a human due to the user’s objection—contrary to the policy to confirm first and hand off if the request cannot be handled. These constitute failure to perform the requested changes correctly and to confirm before writing, so the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
